posts.text:
Unregulated, manufactured THC products have been intentionally designed to look like popular candy and chip brands.  These products are poisoning our children. They are causing severe mental health issues. 
 
We have a responsibility to protect our children. Closing the life-threatening THC loophole is how we do it. 
 
I’m proud to join @SenTedBuddNC in this fight for our children.
posts.summary: Opposes unregulated THC products, calls for closing loophole to protect children

Today, I introduced the Karly Rain Wood Act. In 2022, Karly Rain Wood, a 20-year-old from Omaha, was murdered. Karly Rain’s killer was previously convicted of four different felonies. But he had been released to freely roam our streets.

My bill would create a publicly searchable national registry for repeat violent offenders. Just like with the sex offender registry, Americans would know who is living in their neighborhood. It’s commonsense to keep Nebraska’s streets safe.
posts.summary: Introduces bill to create national violent offender registry, toughen criminal accountability
